review_text_raw:
I don't care what anyone says about this game, I'll never play it again.

The game starts in forced-fullscreen, with no in-game options to disable or change that. Alt-Enter wouldn't work initially until I actually went into the game code to change it. Allegedly, this key combo worked for other people according to the abysmally poor 'support' I got from their discord (which forcefully installs itself into your discord when you launch the game). Alt-Tabbing out of the game forces a full-screen redraw for every single window you have open (who CODES games like this in this era????) and on a system that can support 5 monitors, that means I spent a lot of time waiting for everything to re-draw before I could even turn my attention to the issue below...

The game starts by telling you, "this game is best experienced with a headset on". Okay, great, I intended to play it that way. Then the Kaigan Games logo feces starts up with 200 decibel loud racket, followed by a bunch of industrial noises and screeching they've deemed 'musical'. Thanks, you kntz, are ya paying for the hearing aid I'm going to need after this introduction to your POS software? I seriously had the volume for the game dialed down to 3%, when compared with almost every other game being at 50-100% in the windows mixer. This is WILDLY obnoxious and uncalled-for and something that's easily addressed within the game design.

Then I go talk to 'support', which consists of a single mod literally telling me to try all the things I told him I already DID for the fullscreen issue (oh, almost forgot about 'peanut gallery guy' chiming in with exactly the same stuff as 'mod guy' but ten minutes late). THEN telling me "it's not that loud, just turn it down in Windows mixer". YEAH. Thanks buddy. I DID THAT AFTER your garbage game burst both my eardrums, thanks. HOW am I supposed to know to do that BEFORE bleeding from the ears? Like, SURELY at least one person in this entire game studio must have played the game (on a headset, as they recommended), and thought to themselves, "Gee, maybe this is a bit loud." No volume slider in-game, no independent music-voice-sfx sliders so it's ALL or nothin' with the Windows mixer. GREAT choice guys, leave the game's audio quality in the hands of the people that brought us Windows ME, Vista, 8 and 10. *slowclap*

With this kind of quality product, quality control, quality review, quality support, quality content I look forward to the day when I hear your slapdash company has suffered complete economic failure and I can rest easy knowing I won't have to deal with any further blood in my headphones thanks to you bunch of ridiculous hacks. If there is a higher power, may they see fit to grant each of you the slowest and most painful demise available, all set to the absolute DRECK soundtrack of your own miserable game.
